description: Calculate collateral requirements, developer fee, yield deposit, and estimated recovery days for a zero-net-cost USDC payment on Base.

amount.description: Amount of USDC to pay to the recipient (e.g. 10 or 25.5).

protocol.description: Yield protocol to use. 'auto' (recommended) automatically picks the higher yielding protocol.

name: get_quote

collateralTotal.description: Base collateral plus safety buffer in USDC

estimatedAPY.description: Active APY rate for the chosen protocol

estimatedRecoveryDays.description: Estimated days until earned yield equals payment + fee

selectedProtocol.description: Yield protocol selected for capital recovery

totalRequiredAmount.description: Total USDC needed upfront (payment + fee + yield deposit)

yieldDepositAmount.description: USDC deposited into yield protocol to generate returns
